```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
dat_raw <- read.csv(here::here("P3/DataRaw", "frmgham2.csv"))
```

```{r}
View(dat_raw)
```

Filter to 10 years with TIMESTRK var not TIME var.
Change STROKE var. 
stroke var indicator, time to stroke var, baseline covariates. Need to change the stroke vars likely. Only care about first stroke
```{r}
vars <- c("RANDID", "STROKE", "SEX", "TIMESTRK", "TIME", "AGE", "DIABETES", "SYSBP", "PREVCHD", "BPMEDS", "CURSMOKE", "TOTCHOL", "BMI")

dat_10 <- dat_raw %>%
  filter(TIMESTRK <= 365.25*10) %>%
    # Filter to first 10 years
  group_by(RANDID) %>%
  filter(!(STROKE == 1 & TIME == 0)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    # Remove individuals with previous strokes
  select(all_of(vars))
    # Variables of interest 

```

```{r}
surv_object <- Surv(time = as.numeric(dat_10$TIMESTRK), event = as.factor(dat_10$STROKE))

log_rank <- survdiff(surv_object ~ SEX, data = dat_10)


dat_10 <- dat_10 %>%
  mutate(
    `Time to Censoring` = if_else(`Censoring Status` == 0, `Time Survived in Days after Diagnosis`, NA_real_),
    `Censoring Status` = factor(`Censoring Status`, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Censored", "Died")),
    `Residual Disease Present` = factor(`Residual Disease Present`, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    `ECOG Performance Status` = factor(`ECOG Performance Status`),
    `Treatment Group` = factor(`Treatment Group`, labels = c("Treatment Group 1", "Treatment Group 2"))
  ) 
table1::table1(~`Time Survived in Days after Diagnosis` + `Censoring Status` + `Time to Censoring` + `Age (years)` + `Residual Disease Present` + `ECOG Performance Status` | `Treatment Group`, dat_table)

cox <- coxph(surv_object ~ rx, data = dat_ovarian)
  # Hazard ratio: 1-0.5508=0.4492

cox <- coxph(surv_object ~ rx + age + factor(resid.ds) + factor(ecog.ps), data = dat_ovarian)
  # Hazard ratio: 1 - 0.40072 = 0.59928
```
